headline: Sensex Surges 898 Points to Reclaim 25,800 Defying Global Sell-off Led by Banking Stocks

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Banking stocks led a strong rally, pushing NIFTY Bank to a record high.
Foreign inflows supported Indian benchmark indices, helping them buck the weak trend in global markets.
Markets rebounded after opening lower due to a sell-off in global AI and tech stocks.
Resilient domestic sentiment helped Sensex and Nifty recover early trade losses.
whatHappening: Sensex jumped 898 points while Nifty 50 reclaimed the 25,800 mark to close at 25,801.
IRDAI imposed a penalty of ₹2 crore on Star Health.
SEBI is considering rolling back strict FPI norms to align closer with global standards.
Coal auction rounds received 85 bids, with 20 first-time players entering the sector.
summary: Indian share markets staged a robust recovery on November 20, 2026, with the Sensex surging 898 points and Nifty reclaiming the 25,800 mark. Strong buying in banking stocks and foreign capital inflows drove the rally despite global tech jitters. Among individual stocks, Apollo Hospitals led market gainers, while Star Health faced regulatory pressure following a ₹2 crore penalty from IRDAI.
